label: Attack matrix
description: Attack success is read from a class-and-level matrix against the target armor class.

label: Combat tables
description: Attack success is determined from dedicated combat tables keyed by level and armor class.

label: THAC0
description: Attack rolls are compared to THAC0 minus the target armor class to determine a hit.

label: Attack bonus vs. target AC
description: A d20 roll plus attack bonuses is compared directly to the target ascending armor class.

label: Proficiency attack vs. AC
description: A d20 roll plus ability modifiers and proficiency bonus is compared to the target ascending armor class.
